name: Saner.AI
tagline: From notes about your work to an assistant that does it.
metaTitle: Saner.AI Alternative: An AI Assistant Beyond Your Notes
metaDescription: Looking for a Saner.AI alternative? GAIA acts on your email, calendar and tasks, runs workflows across your tools and works from chat apps and desktop.
whyPeopleLook: Saner.AI is a thoughtful product for people with ADHD: one place for notes, emails and to-dos, with an assistant called Skai that organizes what you capture and drafts a plan each morning. People look for an alternative when their work outgrows the note app. They want replies drafted, meetings booked, tasks created in the tools their team already uses and routines that run on their own, and they want to reach the assistant from the chat apps they already check.
painPoints: Email and calendar arrive as information to read, not work that gets done
No workflow builder for routines that should run on their own
Tasks live in Saner.AI rather than in the task tools your team uses
No way to reach it from WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack or iMessage
Proprietary, with no way to self-host or read the code
gaiaReplaces: Reading emails in Saner.AI and then replying in another app
Copying tasks from your notes into Todoist, Asana or Linear
Morning planning you redo by hand every day
Switching apps to check your calendar before booking a meeting
gaiaAdvantages: Drafts email replies and turns threads into tasks in your own task tool
Workflows on a schedule or triggered by Gmail, Calendar, Slack and GitHub
Reachable from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord
Memory of your preferences that you can view, edit and delete
migrationSteps: Export your notes from Saner.AI and keep the ones you still need in Notion or Google Docs
Connect Gmail or Outlook, your calendar and your task tool to GAIA
Tell GAIA the preferences and routines Saner.AI used to plan around
Rebuild your morning plan as a scheduled GAIA workflow

faqs.question: What is the best Saner.AI alternative?
faqs.answer: It depends on why you are leaving. If you want a different note app, tools such as Mem or Notion AI are closer. If you want an assistant that acts on your email, calendar and tasks and runs workflows for you, GAIA is the closer fit.

faqs.question: Does GAIA take notes like Saner.AI?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA is not a note-taking app. It remembers what you tell it and can write to Notion or Google Docs, but it has no note editor, tagging or folders. Many people keep a note app for notes and use GAIA for the work.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?
faqs.answer: GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).

faqs.question: How do I switch from Saner.AI to GAIA?
faqs.answer: Export the notes you want to keep, connect your email, calendar and task tool to GAIA, then rebuild your morning plan as a scheduled workflow. Move one routine at a time.

comparisonRows.gaia: A personal AI assistant that works across email, calendar, tasks and your other connected tools
comparisonRows.competitor: A note-first AI assistant for ADHD that combines notes, emails and a to-do list in one app

comparisonRows.gaia: Not a note-taking app; it remembers facts and preferences you share and can save content to Notion or Google Docs
comparisonRows.competitor: Core strength: capture by voice, Chrome extension, PDF upload and import, with AI tags, folders and related-note suggestions

comparisonRows.gaia: Triages Gmail and Outlook, drafts replies and turns threads into tasks
comparisonRows.competitor: Pulls in Gmail and shows what needs attention; an Outlook connector arrived in late 2025 as early access

comparisonRows.competitor: Turns emails and brain dumps into tasks, prioritizes them and drafts a daily plan each morning

comparisonRows.gaia: Multi-step workflows on a schedule or triggered by Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, GitHub and more
comparisonRows.competitor: No general workflow builder; proactive help centers on the daily plan and reminders

comparisonRows.gaia: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Todoist, Asana, HubSpot and more, plus custom MCP servers
comparisonRows.competitor: Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar and Google Drive, plus Outlook in early access

comparisonRows.gaia: iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord, plus a web app and a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
comparisonRows.competitor: Web app, Chrome extension and mobile apps for iOS and Android

comparisonRows.gaia: Source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) with self-hosting via Docker; for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license
comparisonRows.competitor: Proprietary and cloud-hosted; says it does not train on, sell or share your data

comparisonRows.gaia: Hosted Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month per person; GAIA Enterprise priced on request
